notes.title: Release Date Postponed
notes.notes:
[p]Frontier Works Inc. has revised the release date of their upcoming title, [i]Heroic Songs: the Remix![/i], to focus on improving the quality of the release. [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Updated Release Date: Wednesday, October 8, 2025[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]We understand this is disappointing news for players eager for the release, but we appreciate your patience and understanding as we focus on releasing a polished product. In the meantime, we will continue to provide updates on the game’s content.[/p][p]
[/p]
